recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-panel grid composition featuring black-and-white ink illustrations of romantic couples and individuals in a 1960s comic book style, interspersed with bold red heart shapes and yellow text boxes.
coreVisualRelationships: Grid-based organization of varying panel sizes
High-contrast black ink line work against flat primary color fields
Large red heart motifs acting as primary and secondary focal points
Yellow rectangular text boxes providing narrative context to each panel
coreInvariants: Thick black outlines on all characters
Ben-Day dot or simple hatching for shading

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main title heart is top-left; a secondary heart is mid-right; character panels fill the remaining grid space at varying scales.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red heart in the top-left corner containing the primary title.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Z-pattern flow starting from the top-left heart, moving through the character panels, and ending at the bottom-right remastered note.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense with information, using white gutters as the only relief.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White and Black (line work and background)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation primaries (Red, Yellow, Blue) against stark black and white values.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy blocky sans-serif for main titles
Cursive brush script for secondary emphasis
Clean, monolinear sans-serif for panel captions
characterSpecificRedesigns: Title letters feature thick black outlines and slight vertical stretching
Script text is angled at approximately 15 degrees
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold blocky display paired with a fluid brush script and functional caption sans.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed blocky feel of the main title.
Approximates the mid-century casual script used for secondary titles.
Provides the clean, legible feel for the panel captions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grid of 8-10 comic book panels featuring 1960s style ink drawings of men and women in romantic or dramatic poses. Use black and white line art with flat color backgrounds (blue, peach, lavender). Include two large red hearts, one in the top left and one in the middle right. Place empty yellow rectangular boxes in the corners of several panels.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold yellow condensed sans-serif text with black outlines inside the top-left heart. Add black uppercase sans-serif text inside the yellow boxes. Add a dark grey brush script title overlapping the top-left heart.

verificationChecks: Are all character illustrations in a consistent 1960s ink style?
Is the grid layout varied in panel size?
Are the yellow text boxes placed clearly within or overlapping the panels?

mustRedesign: Specific character faces to avoid likenesses
Specific song titles and artist names

mustAchieve: Clear visual hierarchy between hearts and panels

postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent line thickness across all panels.
Ensure text is perfectly legible against yellow backgrounds.
Verify that the red hearts are the most saturated elements.
Confirm the grid gutters are clean and white.
recipe.reuseFormula: Comic Grid + Romance Ink Style + Primary Color Accents + Heart Motifs
